composition.description: External buses: the composition last set; null while the bus still draws `layout`
composition.title: Composition

layout.description: Of an external bus: what it was built with and draws until its first composition
layout.title: Layout

mode.description: `follow`: the bus draws `layout` with `scenes`, changed by `PUT …/scenes`, `…/layout` and `…/page`. `external`: the client sets the picture with `PUT …/composition`, and those refuse
mode.title: Mode

revision.description: Changes with every assignment or layout change; `PUT …/scenes` names the one it edits
revision.title: Revision

AuxComposition.description: Direct compositor composition for an AUX bus with `mode: external`.

composition.description: `{"layers":[…],"active_inputs":…}` as `node.object.set … composition` expects; both keys are required
composition.title: Composition

AuxComposition.title: AuxComposition

node.description: The bus's compositor node, as `GET /engine/nodes` names it
node.title: Node

scenes.description: Every slot's scene, by slot index, as the bus reports them; null clears one
scenes.title: Scenes

anyOf.description: Reach Program no earlier than this show tick (two hosts, one frame); the engine needs AVP_CLOCK_ORIGIN=tai
Reach Program no earlier than this show tick (two hosts, one frame); the engine needs AVP_CLOCK_ORIGIN=tai

color.description: Dip through this colour instead of mixing
color.title: Color

FtbChange.description: Fade the keyed Program (not the clean feed) to black, or back.
FtbChange.title: FtbChange

gains.description: Source id to its volume in dB, independent of audio-follow-video
gains.title: Gains

rate.description: The key's own fade length, null while it follows `all_rate`
rate.title: Rate

KeyChange.description:
Either put the key on or off air (`on`, over `fade_seconds`), or set its own rate (`rate`;
null: it follows the rate of all keys again). A rate changes nothing on air.

fade_seconds.description: Default: the key's rate, or else the rate of all keys
fade_seconds.title: Fade Seconds

KeyChange.title: KeyChange

KeyGroupChange.description:
Several keys on one program frame: `on`, `toggle` (each against what is on air), or `prepare`:
the keys that switch with the following background takes, on the take's clock (an empty list
clears the selection; `fade_seconds` and `curve` do not apply to it).

fade_seconds.description: Default: the rate of all keys
fade_seconds.title: Fade Seconds

KeyGroupChange.title: KeyGroupChange

LeverPosition.description:
The lever arm (T-bar). From the end it rests at it mixes to Preview, the other end completes,
its start cancels. Positions sent faster than the mixer takes them collapse to the newest.

duration_sec.description: The mix's length, for AUTO to run it on from the lever
duration_sec.title: Duration Sec

move.description: The lever's take is a move
move.title: Move

seq.description: Numbered per `client`; a position older than one already received is dropped
seq.title: Seq

t_ms.description: When the controller sampled the position, on its own clock: paces positions against network jitter
t_ms.title: T Ms

wipe_file.description: Wipe with this cached clip instead of mixing, its frame following the lever
wipe_file.title: Wipe File

LeverPosition.title: LeverPosition

Move.description:
Layers of a source in both scenes glide from Program's placement to the scene's; it fades
when it cannot glide, and the status `move` says why.

anyOf.description: Reach Program no earlier than this show tick (two hosts, one frame); the engine needs AVP_CLOCK_ORIGIN=tai

unmatched.description: What sources in only one scene do; default fade
unmatched.title: Unmatched

Move.title: Move

Queue.description: One graph edge as `queues.json` reports it: fill, rates and drop counters vary with the build.
Queue.title: Queue

SourceMedia.description:
play / pause / seek / stop / restart on a video source of a mixer built with
`MixerOptions.playback_control`.
SourceMedia.title: SourceMedia

SourcePrepare.description:
Load a URL on a video source, pause on the cue-in frame. Needs
`MixerOptions.playback_control`; an NDI source has no pause or seek.

cue_in_ms.description: Seek to this offset after pause, in milliseconds
cue_in_ms.title: Cue In Ms

SourcePrepare.title: SourcePrepare

duration_ms.description: ffprobe length when known; null for live / unprobeable
duration_ms.title: Duration Ms

SourceResumeAt.description: Schedule resume of the source's pause team at a wallclock time (ms).

at_ms.description: Wallclock ms in the mixer start_pts domain
at_ms.title: At Ms

position_ms.description: Client playhead at resume; echoed only — the engine does not track position
position_ms.title: Position Ms

SourceResumeAt.title: SourceResumeAt

SourceSet.description:
Repoint a wired file / live video (or NDI) source: stop its group safely, set URL and loop,
restart. Browser, raw, MXL and VMM pads refuse the command.
SourceSet.title: SourceSet

pvw_scene.description: Shown to the operator; after a take, the scene that left Program
pvw_scene.title: Pvw Scene

pvw_slot_scene.description: Loaded in the Preview slot, so a take of it is instant; empty while cold
pvw_slot_scene.title: Pvw Slot Scene

superseded.description: A newer take arrived before this one reached the mixer, which took that one instead
superseded.title: Superseded

wipe_file.description: The clip's path on the engine's host; the show's are in the settings' `wipes`
wipe_file.title: Wipe File

Zoom.description:
Glide one person's layer from Program's framing to the scene's instead of cutting, when both
scenes draw one layer of the same source; otherwise the cut is plain and the status `zoom` says why.
Zoom.title: Zoom

put.description:
Set the picture of an external-mode AUX bus (no follower; does not freeze mixer.scene).

200 means the composition was handed to the bus's compositor, which stages it until its
inputs have frames: `GET /mixer/aux` reports `composition_pending` meanwhile and
`composition_error` when the previous picture was kept. A composition the compositor
itself refuses (an input the bus does not have, too many layers) is in the engine's log only.

post.description:
Take a scene to Program. Takes reach the mixer one at a time, in arrival order, and a
newer one supersedes the one still waiting. While a transition is on air, a take acts on
it as a vision switcher's buttons do: a cut completes it.
